title: Calls for Papers for CLeaR2027 Is Now Open
sourceName: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project
content: The call for paper submissions to the 6th conference on Causal Learning and Reasoning (CLeaR 2027) is now open. The submission deadline is November 16, 2026. CLearR 2027 will be held from March 3 to 5 in Paris. Dr. Shohei Shimizu, Team Director of the Causal Inference Team, will serve as a Program Chair alongside Dr. Karthika Mohan of Oregon State University. Conference website: https://www.cclear.cc/2027 Nihonbashi 1-chome Mitsui Building, 15th floor, e-mail: aip-koho [at]riken.jp *Please replace "[at]" with "@".
